select task_id as taskId, #{item.endTime} as statisticalTime, #{item.offsetValue} as second, avg(tx_bps) as txBps from mp_flow_task_record where task_id in
#{record}
and create_time <= #{item.endTime} and create_time > #{item.startTime} group by task_id

select count(1) as taskNum,sum(success_count) as successCount,sum(error_count) as errorCount, sum(success_count+error_count) as runnedCount,count(distinct(node_id)) as totalNode, (SELECT COUNT(1) from mp_flow_task_task where task_status='1' and scene_id=#{sceneId}) as runningTask, (SELECT COUNT(distinct(node_id)) from mp_flow_task_task where task_status='1' and scene_id=#{sceneId}) as runningNode from mp_flow_task_task t where scene_id=#{sceneId}
